---
name: Adapter request
about: Propose or discuss a harness adapter
title: "[adapter] "
labels: adapter
---

**Harness**: name + version + URLs

**Detection signals**: config files, plugin dirs, executables

**Capabilities observed** (honest): tools / commands / hooks / session
lifecycle / cancellation / streaming / file events / worktrees / provider
selection

**Operational proof available?** If you have a fixture or a real install that
proves install/verify/rollback, describe it. Adapters are only promoted to
SUPPORTED after operational proof.

**Note**: creating an adapter does not imply all ECC capabilities are active on
that harness.
